messages:
sophie: Heads-up — the sample app README still references RW_API_KEY in the Node snippet, but our SDK expects REDWOOD_API_KEY (and the TS import example uses a default import which breaks ESM users). Hit this while onboarding a partner app.
aj: Ugh, that explains the 401s I saw. Do you have the exact snippet? I can push a quick fix.
sophie: Paste from README:
```js
// README copy
import client from '@redwood/inference'
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}` }
})
```
maya: Two issues: env var name and default import. Should be:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```
kevin: Also add a note for Windows PowerShell users — env var examples differ. We keep getting copy/paste confusion in onboarding.
aj: I'll open a tiny PR that updates the snippet, adds the ESM/TS note, and adjusts the curl example to use REDWOOD_API_KEY. Anyone object to the quick patch to main?
sophie: No objections. Can we also backport to the v1-readme branch? A few customers still reference that.
kevin: +1 backport. Also file an issue to detect mismatched env var names via docs linting.
maya: I'll add a docs lint rule proposal after the PR lands — detect known legacy keys (RW_* etc.) and flag.
docs-bot: Current README: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/samples/sample-app/README.md :eyes:
aj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/832 — small README updates + ESM note. CI will run.
ci-bot: docs/lint failed on main — snippet-check reported mismatch in sample-app/README.md line 42. See run: https://ci.redwood.ai/123456
sophie: I'll update the onboarding checklist to call out the env var name explicitly so SRE and Solutions don't paste the wrong thing.
kevin: Good. After PR merges, let's add a one-line blurb to the quickstart troubleshooting section about env var names and common copy/paste pitfalls. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks — I'll follow up with the lint rule issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/421 (drafted).
aj: Merged and backported to v1-readme. Deployed to the docs site. Thanks everyone. :tada:
